messages:
alyssa: starting incremental rollout v3.2.1 -> traffic 5% -> target 25% over 30m. change window 22:00-23:00 PT. route: default + edge-eu. deploy-bot: @alyssa initiated rollout job r-4523, plan=staged, steps=5, current=5%. link: https://deploy.internal/r/4523 :rocket:
ben_platform: noted. tagging v3.2.1 for observability dashboards and alerts. pushing release notes to #release-notes in a sec.
carmen_sre: heads-up — initial telemetry looks fine but p95 latency in eu-west-1 is +120ms vs baseline in the last 5m. small sample (n=48). not critical yet but want eyes.
devin_ops: can you paste the query you used Carmen? want to confirm it's not a spike from a single shard.
carmen_sre: query: `SELECT p95_latency FROM traces WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND model='ggml-v2' AND ts > now()-5m`
devin_ops: thanks. running same — seeing a couple of host-level GC pauses on gcp-eu-03.
alyssa: ok — do we want to continue to 10% or pause for investigation?
ben_platform: also seeing a small uptick in 502s (0.4% -> 0.9%) from edge-eu. not huge but correlated with the latency bump window.
carmen_sre: my vote: hold at 5% while we confirm bleedthrough. if infra GC, we can reschedule warmup for that shard and retry.
devin_ops: agree with hold. recommend pin traffic for eu-west-1 back to v3.2.0 for safety, let other regions continue to 10% if infra looks stable.
alyssa: quick vote please: +1 hold 5% and pin eu-west, -1 continue to 10% as planned.
ben_platform: +1 (hold & pin eu-west).
carmen_sre: +1.
devin_ops: +1.
alyssa: consensus reached. deploying hold action now. deploy-bot: pausing rollout r-4523 at current_percent=5, note="hold: eu-west latency bump; pin region eu-west-1 to v3.2.0". action_id=a7b9.
deploy-bot: region pin applied: eu-west-1 -> v3.2.0. rolling back fraction for that region only is not happening; traffic diverted to pinned variant.
alyssa: ops — can you confirm no manual rollback needed? we prefer to investigate warmup and kv-cache behaviour before reverting globally.
devin_ops: confirmed — no global rollback. local pin applied. I'll schedule a warmup on gcp-eu-03 and monitor GC patterns.
carmen_sre: I'll keep an eye on p95 and 5xx rates, will signal if escalation needed.
ben_platform: leaving feature flag gating in place for 10%->25% ramp until post-warmup signoff.
alyssa: thanks all. I'll update the release notes with the hold + region pin, and will close the loop after 30m check. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollout r-4523 status=paused, paused_by=alyssa, paused_at=4523678930, paused_reason="region eu-west-1 latency spike"
alyssa: end-of-thread — holding until follow-up. ping me @here if anything changes."
